system.description:
Requirements: You must be utilizing Mountain King Style

Cost: 1 Focus

You prepare for a mighty strike.

As an Action, spend 1 Focus and select a target creature. If that creature is still within line of sight and within range of your equipped weapon at the end of their next turn, you may attack that enemy twice.

Allies of your Size or smaller do not block line of sight. If another creature blocks your line of sight, you may attack that creature twice instead.

If another creature is between you and the target, you may attack that creature instead.
